title_zh: 新人把便装日穿成了睡衣日
title_en: Funny Stories from Life (17/20): The New Hire Who Turned Casual Day into Pajama Day
note_en: A new hire mistakes "casual day" for "pyjama day" and accidentally starts a new company tradition. Then come more funny office stories: a grumble sent by mistake to the company-wide work chat, a banana plant on the desk as a cure for anxiety, an office cat who acts as the "boss," a fake power cut to stop overtime, and a cake on your last day as the new standard for leaving well.
